summary: The proposed patch simplifies the `_check_homomorphism` function, but it may introduce behavioral regressions and lacks comprehensive tests.

issues.description: The patch changes the logic for handling generators and their inverses, which could potentially break existing behavior in other parts of the codebase.
The patch does not include additional tests to verify that the new implementation correctly handles all cases, including those involving permutation groups and other group types.
The patch introduces a new dictionary `symbols_to_domain_generators`, which may make the code less readable and more prone to errors if not properly maintained.
